description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and bits per character (BPC) for two different validation methods. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50,000, with tick labels at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.1 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A magenta line, marked with crosses, represents “SimSMoE Validating”; it begins at approximately 2.15 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.18 at x=10,000, then continues to decrease to approximately 1.12 at x=20,000, and remains relatively stable around 1.12 to 1.14 until x=50,000. A black line, marked with crosses, represents “SMoE Validating”; it begins at approximately 1.65 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.18 at x=10,000, then continues to decrease to approximately 1.12 at x=20,000, and remains relatively stable around 1.12 to 1.14 until x=50,000.
